title: The immunopathological landscape of human pre-TCRα deficiency: From rare to common variants.

reviewer.method: Personally read all 534 lines of the complete main text, including all methods, 86 references, backmatter and seven legends; all seven original main figure images and every panel. Read all 623 lines of structured supplementary document text, all eight supplementary figures (ten original embedded figure pages), every cell/footnote of 16 supplementary tables and all their rendered page pixels. Read both complete Data S1 sheets (37 x 11 and 137 x 12 cells, with merged-cell/format/footnote inspection), and two clinical reading renderings for all four assigned subjects. All four assigned packets, including two alternates, four alleles and 61 phenotype items personally compared. Preparation is not reading. Three external Dryad adjunct files unavailable, with no reading credit. This is new review work; no inherited canonical replaced.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.

limitations: Complete main publication and both attached clinical supplements personally read; three small Dryad adjunct originals unavailable. Record remains incomplete despite full clinical reading.

Definite contradictions: P4 excluded hepatitis versus Data S1 chronic hepatitis; P3 increased total lymphocytes versus serial blood lymphopenia. P4 allergy and P5 excluded fatigability remain unresolved.
P3 congenital onset cannot be transferred from the coexisting USP9X syndrome; partial clinical penetrance and founder relationships retained.
Data S1 has date-coerced reference-range cells L117/L119; these were inspected as stored mmm-yy dates and no clinical threshold was reconstructed from them.
Bulk GEO/BioProject/TCR sequence datasets and author-controlled biological material were not requested or reanalyzed; no wet-lab design/execution, UI or contacts.
Historical HG002/FGFR2 public-control rank exposure declared per_case; no target-case inference or benchmark outcome files consulted. No blinded claim.
